name: Reka Krka
subtitle: od jezu HE v Zagradcu do jezu v Soteski

en.name: The river Krka
en.subtitle: from the dam of the hydropower plant Zagradec to the dam in Soteska
en.description: The riverbed of the river Krka is composed of many natural thresholds, which are sheated in tufa (a variety of limestone). Many pools and cascades are overgrown with green moss and offer many hiding places for the fish. The water temperature is relatively stable, so that the living conditions for fish are always optimal.

description: Struga reke Krke je sestavljena iz številnih naravnih pragov, ki so obloženi s lehnjakom. Številni tolmuni in kaskade so porasle z zelenim mahom, ki nudijo ribam številna skrivališča. Temperatura vode je razmeroma stabilna, tako da so razmere za življenje rib ves čas optimalne. Spomladi in v zgodnjem poletju je ob rojenju enodnevnic, majskih muh, šašev in prodnic izjemno uspešen lov s suho muho.

name: Reka Krka
subtitle: od jezu v Soteski do Mršeče vasi

en.name: The river Krka
en.subtitle: from the dam in Soteska to Mršeča vas
en.description: The central and lower part of the fishing district on the river Krka are rich with many cyprinid species, among which dominate Danube roaches, chubs, common nases, pikes and catfish. From Novo mesto to Otočec the fishing is great from dams-the Krka is famous for them-especially in the hot summer days whether you fish for Danube roaches,common nases or pikes.

description: Osrednji in spodnji del revirja na reki Krki sta bogata z mnogimi ciprinidnimi vrstami, med katerim prevladujejo platnice, kleni, podusti, ščuke in somi. Od Novega mesta do Otočca je z jezov, znamenitih za Krko, v vročih poletnih dneh odličen ribolov platnice ali podusti ter ščuke. Užitek si dodatno lahko popestrimo ob ribolovu s čolna, saj je že sama vožnja z njim po zeleni lepotici pravi užitek.

name: Potok Radeščica
subtitle: Radešca

en.name: The creek radeščica
en.subtitle: Radešca
en.description: The Radeščica is a right tributary of the river Krka below Soteska. Its source is in a karst lake at the foot of Kočevski Rog. A few kilometers long stream runs past Dolenjske Toplice and is in full flow well inhabited by brown and rainbow trouts, graylings join them in the lower part. Occasionally some huchen from theKrka wanders in it..

description: Radeščica je desni pritok reke Krke pod Sotesko. Njegov izvir je kraško jezerce v podnožju Kočevskega roga. Nekaj kilometrov dolg potok teče mimo Dolenjskih Toplic in je v celotnem toku dobro naseljen s potočno postrvjo in šarenko, lipan pa se jima pridruži v spodnjem delu. Občasno vanj zaide tudi sulec iz Krke. Kot na večini kraških voda sta tudi na Radeščici najuspešnejša pomladanski in zgodnji poletni ribolov.

name: Ribnik Blato

en.name: The pond Blato
en.description: The pond Blato is situated in an idyllic setting of the hills of the region Dolenjska, not far from Trebnje. The pond is 1.2 ha big and in it there are various cyprinid species: most of them carps, followed by tenches, common breams and zanders.

description: Ribnik Blato je v idiličnem okolju dolenjskih gričev, nedaleč od Trebnjega. Ribnik obsega 1,2 ha, v njem pa so različne ciprinidne vrste: največ je krapov, sledijo jim linji, ploščiči in smuči.
